assay_or_perturbation: Collagen-I stimulation; DDR2/JAK2/ERK inhibition; PEA3, c-Jun and c-Fos promoter occupancy; DDR1/MMP10 expression
evidence_summary: Collagen I induced DDR1 and MMP10 through DDR2 and JAK2/ERK1/2, with PEA3 and AP-1 promoter recruitment.
limitations: Fibroblast matrix-remodeling comparator; not an SCI-specific terminal-TF assignment.

assay_or_perturbation: Collagen-I binding; DDR1/DDR2 activation; matrix remodeling and migration assays
evidence_summary: Collagen I was linked to discoidin-domain receptor activation and matrix-remodeling responses.
limitations: Exact cell type, receptor balance and terminal TF output vary across source systems.

assay_or_perturbation: Collagen-I adhesion; α2β1 blocking/perturbation; spreading and actin-remodeling assays
evidence_summary: Collagen-I/α2β1 interactions were associated with cell adhesion, spreading and actin remodeling.
limitations: No terminal TF or SCI receiver-cell program was assigned.
